title: ProvenanceActivity
description: A record of how an entity, relation candidate, or evidence record was generated, reprocessed, reviewed, or verified. RULE: confidence belongs to an ACTIVITY or assessment, not to immutable source evidence. Multiple activities over the SAME evidence occurrence MUST NOT inflate the number of independent evidence records (see RelationEvidence.EvidenceKey).

id.description: Opaque, unique identifier for this activity.

endedAt.description: When the activity ended, if known.

confidence.description: Confidence produced by THIS activity/assessment. Belongs to the activity, not to the evidence.

inputIds.description: Identifiers of inputs consumed by the activity.

outputIds.description: Identifiers of outputs produced by the activity.
